questions.text: Does the prospect have a clearly defined Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)?
Is there a documented sales process mapped to the buyer's journey?
Are sales goals aligned with broader business objectives?
How effectively does the team handle objection handling?
Are sales targets consistently met or exceeded?
Is there a structured onboarding program for new hires?
Is the CRM used as the single source of truth?
Are sales enablement tools (e.g., outreach, recording) utilized effectively?
